profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at SCIEX
profile.summary:
•	Proficient in software coding and debugging skills across multiple interfaces, languages and architectures.
•	Familiar with FDA regulations govern quality system and development of medical devices.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led the software development of the BioPhase 8800, a cutting-edge multi-capillary electrophoresis system, offering technical expertise and guidance to both internal and contracted developers throughout the development lifecycle.
•	Collaborated closely within a cross-functional team to define features and requirements, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
•	Designed and implemented software driver for interfacing BioPhase 8800 instrument with Waters Empower software.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed firmware for the BioPhase 8000 system, responsible for various subsystems such as Optics, Galvo, Transport, and Pressure controller. Additionally, developed a communication library between firmware and software over USB Serial/CAN bus interface.
•	Architected the software and communication framework based on message queuing with MQTT and microservices architecture.
•	Designed and implemented the BioPhase Firmware service, a service application to process high-level software commands, perform, and monitor firmware communication.
•	Developed the BioPhase Method Run Engine service, a scheduler for processing and running sequences and methods.
•	Developed the BioPhase Front Panel application, the user interface for the BioPhase instrument, running on a touchscreen embedded computer.
•	Developed the BioPhase Service & Manufacturing application, software tools for field service and manufacturing engineering to test, set up, and manufacture the BioPhase instruments.
Keywords: C#, C++, Keil ARM, WPF, WCF, MQTT, microservice, IoC, Mvvm, Git

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Clinical Informatics group on DxOne, a suite of workflow and data analytical  applications leveraging Big Data and cloud computing.
Keywords: Java, Spring, JSP, ES6, Node.js, React.js, Bootstrap, Eclipse, Docker, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Tomcat, Maven. 

Worked with the Automation group on Toccata project, Beckman Coulter's next generation automation system.
•	Responsible the software architecture and infrastructure of the Process Control Layer.  Architecture design is based on inversion of control principle with dependency injection, and supports multi-threading model with custom thread scheduler/task dispatcher extending .NET TPL.
•	Developed the Catalog Manager and System Builder application, a suite of graphical CAD like application that enables service engineers to draw the layout of the lab.  From the drawn layout, and with system block data from Catalog Manager, the software generates various configuration files for all of the software layers, innovated design captured in U.S. Patent US10089434B2.
•	Developed the System Configurator application, a utility used by field service engineers to deploy the system in the field.
•	Developed and supported software build and configuration, automated test and released builds via TFS. 
•	Developed the software installer using WiX to build MSI Windows install package.
•	Developed the framework laying out the foundation for Toccata graphics library, various Toccata test utilities and simulation toolset.
•	Nominated for company wise Excellence in Innovation award in 2017

Keywords:  C#, WCF, WPF, WiX, Unity, IoC, Mvvm, TPL, MSI, MsBuild, TFS, MSBuild.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with Danaher op-co AB Sciex to build an interface between Beckman capillary electrophoresis instrument and Sciex mass spectrometer.  Took the initiate during downtime between projects to work on a feasibility replacement for the Agilent 32Karat software that interfaces and controls Beckman CE instrument.  Innovated idea for an improved software editor for electrophoretic method development.

Worked with the Life Science group on the Optimal XPN Ultracentrifuge
•	Developed boot loader software for embedded controller
•	Developed high speed serial driver for communication between firmware and main application.
•	Developed RESTful service with WCF for external control of the instrument via the web or from mobile device
•	Worked with the development team various UI development and innovations resulting in U.S. Patent 20140235421.
•	Developed the companion iOS application for controlling the system, application is free to download on  iTunes and Play Store as Mobile Fuge
•	Developed an automation test framework that was instrumental in the  localization testing of the product.
•	Awarded Excellence in Innovation award in 2012

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the Brea Platform Development team on several projects including the Unicel DxC600/800, DxC600i and DxC880i chemistry analyzer (Class II medical device) from start to successful launch.
•	Provided support to other functional groups, identified and trouble-shoot software defects.
•	Developed and reviewed software requirements and validation test procedures. Assisted project lead in test planning, failure mode-effects analysis (FMEA) and requirements traceability documentation.
•	Developed system simulation software to test console GUI functionalities and TCP/IP communication utilizing reflective, network and multi-threading programming.  Software is configurable via plug-in and XML sequence files to change simulated behaviors and handle various message formats.
•	Developed a variety of internal software tools including UDP data logger, alignment file editor, utility to send test commands, download and program smart module over 9-bit serial protocol.

Keywords: C#, WCF, WPF, iOS, REST,  MVC, Centrifuge, ASP.NET, Git

positions.title: Lead Developer (part-time)
positions.description:
•	Developed T3POS, a Point-of-Sale, accounting, appointment and clienteles’ database software application for the beauty salon industry using Java and MySQL utilizing Swing, Hibernate, Velocity and JasperReport framework.
•	Developed software applications for iPhone, releases including: 
Sketch Artist a fun software for making police sketch.
FourSquare, a financial calculator application. 
•	Developed DryMonkey, an automation software that interfaces with Amazon Marketplace Web Service (Amazon MWS) to create shipping label and fulfill orders on Amazon Seller Central.

Keywords: Java, MySQL, Swing, Hibernate, iOS, Objective-C, Linux, SVN, AMWS, AWS, Azure

positions.title: Electrical Design Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the engineering team to design and develop the Lifevest, a compact Wearable Cardio Monitor/Defibrillator (Class III device). System was granted FDA Pre-Market Approval in 2002.
•	Responsible for the design of the computer section of the main board, improved on the original design, reduced cost and PCB size by shifting functionalities into the CPLD.
•	CPLD design with VHDL to perform: Hamming Code ECC calculation, programmable baud clock generator, system interrupt generator, system watchdog timer, I/O control signals, memory address decoder, SPI and I2C interface.
•	Designed circuits to supervise the DSP and control high-energy pulse delivery circuit during patient treatment, system is expected to maintain operation in the event of the processor failure.
•	Integrated third-party Bluetooth module into existing design to allow wireless patient’s data transfer via Serial Port Profile.
•	Developed the DSP firmware loader, bootstrap code and Windows software utility to support in-system programming.  Innovation in fault-tolerant programming captured in U.S. Patent Application 20030095648.
•	Developed software interface for ECG data storage with high-density NAND flash.
•	Developed software driver for the NOR flash, Real Time Clock, Maxim 1-Wire Serial interface and graphical LCD, developed graphical routines to plot ECG on LCD in real-time.
•	Developed ADPCM algorithm decoding software for speech messages playback engine with compressed audio data.
•	Developed Windows software utilities (utilizing MFC) to render S-record file from Windows Bitmap and Wave files to support the system multi-lingual operations.
•	Provided engineering support during debugging and testing for IEC/UL and EMC certification.
•	Performed failure analysis of units in the field and in production, compiled reports and proposed corrective actions.

Keywords: C/C++, VHDL, Embedded

positions.title: Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed gas detection systems with life preserving implications.
•	Design and programming of the keypad interface module and the infrared remote control for the Polytron XP gas detection system with Microchip PIC micro-controller.
•	Redesigned the gas sensor simulator for the Intellisense, PointGard and ND-TOX gas detection systems for in-house usage by services engineers.
•	Maintained bill of materials, built and tested prototype Intellisense gas detection circuits.

patents.title: Method and system for forming site network
patents.description: A method for creating a laboratory automation system is disclosed. The method includes obtaining a plurality of subgraphs that correspond to a plurality of system blocks. The system blocks are chosen and the subgraphs are stitched together to form a site graph for the laboratory automation system.

patents.title: Improved centrifuge and method
patents.description: A centrifuge device displays a workflow diagram during operation. The workflow diagram includes a loading step-indicator, a running step-indicator, and an unloading step-indicator. The loading step-indicator is displayed when the centrifuge device is operating in a loading mode. The running step-indicator is displayed when the centrifuge device is operating in a running mode. The unloading step-indicator is displayed when the centrifuge device is operating in the unloading mode. A centrifuge system includes the centrifuge device and a handheld device operable remote from the centrifuge device, which displays a status of the centrifuge device. Methods of operating a centrifuge device and a centrifuge system are also disclosed.
